functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.slack_version_immutable()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin raise exception 'Slack source versions are immutable' using errcode='55000'; end $function$
